title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Lexus LFA
description:
The Lexus LFA has a V ten engine that revs from idle to its redline in point six of a second. That is so fast that the engineers could not use an ordinary needle for the tachometer. And that is only one of two things about this car that almost nobody knows. The other involves a machine, a loom, that Wikipedia says is one of only two of its kind in the world. Here is the twist. Toyota spent about ten years on this car, and Wikipedia says it built only five hundred. Today those five hundred cars sell for more than double what they cost new. But the two things we are going to show you have nothing to do with price. They are about how the car was made, and how it was tuned to sound.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

19:41 What the two surprises tell you
